Some customers have cake ideas that seem almost impossible to pull off. At Carlo's Bakery, Buddy Valastro and his talented team take on unusual requests, turning ambitious concepts into amazing cakes with creative designs and professional cake decorating. From imagining the finished creation to bringing every detail to life, these Cake Boss highlights show what happens when big ideas meet serious baking skills.
Watch Cake Boss Season 9 Episodes 19, 24, 15, 26, 2, 21 and 30 only on discovery+ India.
